import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-friendly
colors = {
    'VLA-only': '#999999',
    'Random':   '#E69F00',
    'Argmin':   '#D55E00',
    'CRM':      '#0072B2',
}

methods = ['VLA-only', 'Random', 'Argmin', 'CRM']

k5_means  = [11.3, 10.5, 13.7, 16.0]
k5_stds   = [1.2,  2.9,  1.2,  2.2]

k10_means = [11.3, 11.7, 12.3, 17.6]
k10_stds  = [1.2,  2.3,  2.6,  2.6]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))

n = len(methods)
bar_width = 0.16
group_gap = 0.12
group_width = n * bar_width

x_groups = np.array([0, group_width + group_gap])

for i, method in enumerate(methods):
    x_pos = x_groups + i * bar_width
    means = [k5_means[i], k10_means[i]]
    stds  = [k5_stds[i],  k10_stds[i]]
    ax.bar(x_pos, means, bar_width * 0.88, yerr=stds,
           color=colors[method], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
           capsize=2.5, error_kw={'linewidth': 1.0, 'capthick': 1.0},
           label=method, zorder=3)

# VLA-only baseline dashed line
ax.axhline(y=11.3, color='#999999', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
ax.text(x_groups[1] + group_width + 0.02, 11.3, 'VLA-only\nbaseline',
        va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8, color='#666666')

# X-axis
group_centers = x_groups + (n - 1) * bar_width / 2
ax.set_xticks(group_centers)
ax.set_xticklabels(['K = 5', 'K = 10'])

ax.set_ylabel('Task Success Rate (%)')
ax.set_ylim(0, 23)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 24, 5))

# --- Annotations ---

# Helper to draw a bracket between two bars with a delta label
def annotate_delta(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, label, color, y_offset=0.8, side='right'):
    y_top = max(y1, y2) + y_offset
    bracket_y = y_top + 0.3
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x1, y1), xytext=(x1, bracket_y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, lw=0.8))
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x2, bracket_y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, lw=0.8))
    ax.plot([x1, x2], [bracket_y, bracket_y], color=color, lw=0.8)
    mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
    ax.text(mid_x, bracket_y + 0.3, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=8, color=color, fontweight='bold')

# K=5 positions
k5_random_x = x_groups[0] + 1 * bar_width
k5_argmin_x = x_groups[0] + 2 * bar_width
k5_crm_x    = x_groups[0] + 3 * bar_width

# K=10 positions
k10_random_x = x_groups[1] + 1 * bar_width
k10_argmin_x = x_groups[1] + 2 * bar_width
k10_crm_x    = x_groups[1] + 3 * bar_width

# Correction delta (CRM vs Argmin) — K=5
annotate_delta(ax,
               k5_argmin_x, k5_means[2] + k5_stds[2],
               k5_crm_x, k5_means[3] + k5_stds[3],
               f'Δ={k5_means[3]-k5_means[2]:.1f}%\ncorrection',
               '#0072B2', y_offset=0.5)

# Correction delta (CRM vs Argmin) — K=10
annotate_delta(ax,
               k10_argmin_x, k10_means[2] + k10_stds[2],
               k10_crm_x, k10_means[3] + k10_stds[3],
               f'Δ={k10_means[3]-k10_means[2]:.1f}%\ncorrection',
               '#0072B2', y_offset=0.5)

# Random K=5 below baseline: downward arrow
ax.annotate('',
            xy=(k5_random_x, k5_means[1] - k5_stds[1] - 0.3),
            xytext=(k5_random_x, k5_means[1] - k5_stds[1] - 1.8),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#E69F00', lw=1.5))
ax.text(k5_random_x, k5_means[1] - k5_stds[1] - 2.1,
        '< baseline', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5,
        color='#B07800', fontstyle='italic')

ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False, ncol=4,
          bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.02), columnspacing=1.0)

ax.set_xlim(x_groups[0] - bar_width * 0.8, x_groups[1] + group_width + 0.15)

plt.tight_layout()

out_path = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_8/projects/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/docs/paper/figures/fig3_decomposition.pdf'
fig.savefig(out_path)
print(f'Saved to {out_path}')

import os
size = os.path.getsize(out_path)
print(f'File size: {size} bytes')

    means = [k5_means[i], k10_means[i]]
    stds  = [k5_stds[i],  k10_stds[i]]
    ax.bar(x_pos, means, bar_width * 0.88, yerr=stds,
           color=colors[method], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,

# --- Annotations ---

# Helper to draw a bracket between two bars with a delta label
def annotate_delta(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, label, color, y_offset=0.8, side='right'):
    y_top = max(y1, y2) + y_offset
    bracket_y = y_top + 0.3
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x1, y1), xytext=(x1, bracket_y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, lw=0.8))
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x2, bracket_y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, lw=0.8))
    ax.plot([x1, x2], [bracket_y, bracket_y], color=color, lw=0.8)
    mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
    ax.text(mid_x, bracket_y + 0.3, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=8, color=color, fontweight='bold')

# K=5 positions
k5_random_x = x_groups[0] + 1 * bar_width
k5_argmin_x = x_groups[0] + 2 * bar_width
k5_crm_x    = x_groups[0] + 3 * bar_width

# K=10 positions
k10_random_x = x_groups[1] + 1 * bar_width
k10_argmin_x = x_groups[1] + 2 * bar_width
k10_crm_x    = x_groups[1] + 3 * bar_width

# Random K=5 below baseline: downward arrow
ax.annotate('below\nbaseline',
            xy=(k5_random_x, k5_means[1]),

ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False, ncol=4,
